scope: Actual UI/interval helpers with synthetic local persistence and mocked authentication; not hosted or staff/provider acceptance
checks: Day/Night/Custom/Off requires no custom times for Off; job roles see appropriate choices; cook splits save as two blocks/nine hours and no automatic clinical coverage.
Desktop/mobile grid fits and scrolls accessibly; publication locks cells; landscape print preserves saved blocks and colors.
Options begin with explicit empty hours/roles, support an added third care choice, and later rename/deactivation does not rewrite published snapshots.
My Schedule and kiosk/timecard/payroll comparison render the same saved split blocks; actual worked minutes and clock actions remain independent.
Swap review displays both saved cook blocks and their nine-hour total as one complete group.
